mechanism: Ashwagandha may alter thyroid hormone regulation and interfere with levothyroxine absorption.
recommendation: Do not combine ashwagandha with levothyroxine without clinician oversight. Thyroid hormone levels need monitoring.

mechanism: Ashwagandha has sedative properties that add to benzodiazepine CNS depression.
recommendation: Avoid combining with benzodiazepines. If sedative use is medically required, consult the prescribing physician.

mechanism: Additive sedative effect with CNS depressants.
recommendation: Avoid combining with sedatives. Do not drive or operate machinery until cleared by a clinician.

mechanism: Curcumin inhibits platelet aggregation and may potentiate warfarin anticoagulation.
recommendation: Do not take therapeutic-dose turmeric with warfarin. INR must be monitored by the prescriber.

mechanism: Additive gastrointestinal bleeding risk with NSAIDs.
recommendation: Caution: therapeutic turmeric with NSAIDs increases GI bleeding risk. Prefer food-grade amounts.

mechanism: Glycyrrhizin increases potassium loss and potentiates thiazide diuretics.
recommendation: Do not combine licorice with thiazide diuretics. Risk of dangerous hypokalemia.

mechanism: Licorice can raise blood pressure and worsen potassium handling on ACE inhibitors.
recommendation: Caution: licorice may blunt the effect of ACE inhibitors and worsen potassium loss. Discuss with prescriber.

mechanism: Senna glycosides in triphala increase digoxin toxicity risk through electrolyte shifts.
recommendation: Do not combine triphala with digoxin. This combination is dangerous.

mechanism: Guggul may alter INR in patients on warfarin.
recommendation: Caution: monitor INR if guggul is used with warfarin. Discuss with prescriber.

mechanism: Brahmi has cholinergic activity that may add to cholinesterase inhibitors.
recommendation: Caution: theoretical additive cholinergic effect with donepezil. Discuss with prescriber.

mechanism: Theoretical phytoestrogen activity may interact with hormonal therapies.
recommendation: Caution: theoretical interaction with tamoxifen. Discuss with oncologist before use.

mechanism: High-dose ginger inhibits platelet aggregation and may add to warfarin.
recommendation: Caution at high doses: monitor INR. Culinary ginger is generally safe.

mechanism: Guduchi may add to the glucose-lowering effect of metformin.
recommendation: Do not combine guduchi with metformin without glucose monitoring. Risk of hypoglycemia.

mechanism: Guduchi may add to sulfonylurea glucose-lowering.
recommendation: Do not combine guduchi with glimepiride without glucose monitoring.

mechanism: Classical texts describe uterotonic and abortifacient effects of ashwagandha.
recommendation: Classical caution: ashwagandha is not recommended during pregnancy. Consult an Ayurvedic practitioner.

mechanism: Purgative herbs in triphala are not appropriate for young children without practitioner guidance.
recommendation: Caution: triphala is not appropriate for children under 12 without practitioner guidance. Do not self-dose.

mechanism: Theoretical risk of additive potassium retention in renal impairment.
recommendation: Caution: theoretical potassium-retention risk with ACE inhibitors in renal impairment. Discuss with nephrologist.

mechanism: Glycyrrhizin increases potassium loss and potentiates HCTZ.
recommendation: Do not combine licorice with hydrochlorothiazide. Risk of dangerous hypokalemia.
